business: The Aldera: magnesium in single-serve capsule sachets (pure bisglycinate and a 3-form complex)
target: US women and men 24-45 who buy supplements on TikTok Shop after creator videos about sleep, stress, magnesium and wellness routines

segments.name: Urban professional woman with a busy day outside home

behaviours.name: Impulse buyer from creator videos
behaviours.how: Buys from the orange cart when a creator's video hits a problem you have, rarely compares.

behaviours.name: Already takes a multi-form complex
behaviours.how: Takes Toplux 8-forms or a 12-in-1 bought in a flash sale for about $15 and reorders when it runs out.

behaviours.name: Deal hunter
behaviours.how: Waits for flash sales and coupons, compares price per day.

behaviours.name: Reads the label
behaviours.how: Checks elemental dose, forms, oxide, third-party testing before buying.

behaviours.name: On-the-go routine person
behaviours.how: Lives out of a tote bag, forgets pills at home, travels or sleeps away from home often.

behaviours.name: Skeptic of supplements
behaviours.how: Thinks most supplements are marketing unless there is proof.

behaviours.name: Hates swallowing pills
behaviours.how: Prefers gummies or drink mixes, big capsules are a dealbreaker.

objections: $29.99 is double what I paid for Toplux 8 forms in a flash sale, and that bottle lasts 3 months
Why only 3 forms when others have 8 or 14 in one capsule?
I take magnesium at night at home, why would I need a sachet to go?
Two capsules a day, and size 00 capsules are big
A QR code and 'lab-tested' sounds like marketing, everyone says tested
Will I actually feel a difference in sleep or cramps?
30 little foil packets feels like more trash
habits: you scroll TikTok in bed before sleep
you keep vitamins on the kitchen counter and forget them half the time
you go to the gym three times a week
you travel for work twice a month
you already have a drawer full of half-used supplement bottles
you watched several videos saying magnesium glycinate helps sleep
you carry a big tote bag with makeup, charger and snacks every day
you stay over at your partner's place a few nights a week
